q1.question:
In vial.py, the Vial class calls the super() function inside its constructor:

class Vial(HTTPServer):
    def __init__(self, host, port):
        super().__init__((host, port), VialRequestHandler)
    ...

Which of the following statements are true (choose all that apply)?

responses.single: super() always refers to the direct parent class in single inheritance.
responses.multiple: super() always refers to the direct parent class in multiple inheritance.
responses.recursive: super().__init__ in this case redirects to the __init__ of Vial.
responses.httpserver: super().__init__ in this case redirects to the __init__ of HTTPServer.

q3.question:
